§aYour analog circuits won't cut it for what's coming next.§f

Once you've got the Soldering Station running, you can start making the higher-tier circuit boards that reactors, warheads, and fusion all demand.

§6Integrated Circuit Board§f: Your first upgrade. Adds microchips to the mix. You'll need the arc furnace for silicon wafers. Used in geiger counters, missiles, and mid-game machines.

§6Military Grade Circuit Board§f: The workhorse of late game. Needs sulfuric acid and rubber, plus heavy capacitor and microchip investment. Goes into particle accelerators, nuclear warheads, and advanced reactors.

§6Versatile Circuit Board§f: The expensive one. Bismuth, hard plastic, and solvent. Each board eats roughly 55 insulators. Reserved for fusion reactors and hydrotreaters.

§6Control Units§f: The Control Unit handles mid-late nukes like Gadget. The Advanced Control Unit adds atomic clocks for Ivy Mike tier.

§ePS:§f Military Grade is the one you'll make the most. Automate rubber, sulfuric acid, and tantalium before you start scaling.
